prompt: Compare manual review with straight-through applications.

results.text: Straight-through applications approve at 88.0% with an average 4 minutes to decision. Manual review approves at 61.0% with an average 214 minutes to decision, which is the expected trade-off: review exists to catch the harder cases, at the cost of speed.

sql.command:
SELECT review_path, product_id, applications, approval_rate, avg_minutes_to_decision
FROM aa_digital_review_comparison
ORDER BY applications DESC
